points.description: States that a rating curve is valid only under normal, non-flood flow conditions, i.e. when there is no flood (flood must be mentioned explicitly).
States that there must be no overflow (water spilling over the banks/channel) in the region; both overflow and flood together form the complete condition 'no overflow or flood in a region'.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the precise condition: no overflow and no flood in the region. Each of the two terms (flood, overflow) is worth one mark; a student naming only one gets 1 mark. Vague statements such as 'stable conditions' or 'normal flow' without naming flood/overflow, or any wrong condition (e.g. 'only during floods'), earn nothing for that point.
